entries.title: Job 25:1
segments: ¶And Bildad the Shuhite answered and said,

entries.title: Job 25:2
segments: Dominion and fear are with him; he maketh peace in his high places.

entries.title: Job 25:3
segments: Is there any number of his troops? and upon whom doth not his light arise?

entries.title: Job 25:4
segments: And how should man be just with *God? Or how should he be clean that is born of a woman?

entries.title: Job 25:5
segments: Lo, even the moon is not bright; and the stars are not pure in his sight:

entries.title: Job 25:6
segments: How much less man, a worm, and the son of man, a worm!
